regime_context: China A-shares detector shows a narrowing rotation (8 of 22 themes eligible, absorption 0.32) with Gold Miners as the durable leader (durability 0.91, max breadth) and Industrial Metals the strongest scorable challenger. Backtest verdict explicitly flags gate_helps=false (trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this history) and rank-IC ~0, so all leans must be humble and conditional; overall the tape reads mean-reverting, not a clean trend regime.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Industrial Metals (512400.SS) closes the rotation margin with Gold Miners and simultaneously holds breadth above 0.8 for five consecutive sessions — that would retire the watch as a confirmed handoff toward a scorable metals theme.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Scorable proxy 512400.SS is eligible with the second-strongest score (1.302) and solid breadth (0.846), and it is the direct challenger to Gold Miners by rotation margin. Absolute-trend gate is not validated here (mean-revert whipsaw), so this is a durability-based lean on the strongest theme that actually has a scorable ETF, framed as a conditional continuation rather than an edge claim.
evidence: rotation.challenger is cn_metals with narrow margin to leader
theses.dissent: Mixed Hurst tag and a mean-reverting tape (gate_helps=false) mean the recent leadership may simply be a bounce; cross-sectional momentum has no validated forward edge, so continuation odds are near coin-flip.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS closes more than 8% below its level on 2026-09-09 before the 20-day check-by date
